messages:
🎉 Barcelona · Mon 23 Nov
No Argentine nights or tardeos found for Mon/Tue. Coming up: Bresh at Apolo on Wed 25, Los Fabulosos Cadillacs at Sant Jordi Club on Fri 27.

TODAY · Mon 23 Nov

1. Fira de Nadal de la Sagrada Família (Christmas market)
🕘 Today 10:00 → 21:00 · 📍 Plaça de la Sagrada Família
📊 1,968 likes on @planesenbarcelona's post
💶 Free entry
💬 The city's first Christmas market of the season, open since Saturday: stalls, churros and crêpes under the Sagrada Família. A stroll with friends you already have, not a meet-people night. Expect a steady crowd of hundreds; shuts at 21:00.
https://www.instagram.com/p/DgDok80BUuK/

2. Piñata presenta: Infinity Song
🕘 Tonight 19:30 → 22:45 · 📍 SALA APOLO
📊 no public headcount (DICE doesn't publish one)
💶 €27.70
💬 New York sibling soft-rock band with big harmonies, in Apolo's smaller room. No headcount on DICE, but Apolo is pushing it in today's stories and weekly agenda; expect a couple of hundred. The one proper gig tonight.
https://dice.fm/event/92rg66-piata-presenta-infinity-song-23rd-nov-sala-apolo-barcelona-tickets

3. NOMAD RUN ★ 6KM with Entrepreneurs & Digital Nomads feat. La Fabrica &Co ROOFTOP
🕘 Tonight 19:00 → 21:00 · 📍 La Fabrica & Co
📊 30 going on Meetup · group has 15,746 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Easy 6 km run with founders and digital nomads, ending with drinks on a Poblenou coworking rooftop. A place to meet new people in tech; expect 30–40, also listed on Eventbrite.
https://www.meetup.com/barcelona-digital-nomads-community/events/316897819/

4. Tapantoni — Sant Antoni tapas route
🕘 Today, hours not stated · 📍 Bars around the Sant Antoni neighbourhood
📊 Featured in @planesenbarcelona's round-up (1,376 likes); runs 13–29 Nov
💶 Tapa + drink €3.80
💬 Bar-hop Sant Antoni with friends: each bar on the map does one tapa plus a drink at a set price. A go-with-your-group plan, busy on weekends, quieter on a Monday. The post gives no hours, so check the map first.
https://www.instagram.com/p/Df4_g09jU8J/

TOMORROW · Tue 24 Nov

1. Kingfishr — European tour
🕘 Tue 19:30 (some listings say 20:30) · 📍 Sala Apolo (main room)
📊 Main-room show on Sala Apolo's agenda for the week
💶 From €34
💬 Irish folk-pop trio on their album tour, the biggest gig in town on Tuesday. Apolo's main room, so expect several hundred up to about a thousand. Sources differ on start time; Apolo itself says 19:30.
https://sala-apolo.com/en/event/kingfishr-20261124-7426

2. Christmas videomapping at Plaça de Sant Jaume
🕘 Tue 18:30 → 22:00 · 📍 Plaça de Sant Jaume
📊 643 likes on @barcelonasecreta's post
💶 Free
💬 Light projections on the City Hall and Generalitat façades, with music at 18:30, 19:30 and 20:30. You stand in the square for 15 minutes, then go for dinner in the Gòtic; a plan with friends. A few hundred per session.
https://www.instagram.com/p/DgCcS2yDEqK/

3. Christian Löffler - Until We Meet Again Tour
🕘 Tue 19:30 → 22:30 · 📍 Teatre Coliseum
📊 39 interested on RA
💬 German melodic-electronica producer playing a live show in a seated theatre rather than a club. Modest RA interest but a known touring name in a big room; expect several hundred. Good if you want music without a late night.
https://ra.co/events/2489831

4. FREE GUEST LIST · Moods at Noxe (26th floor W Barcelona)
🕘 Tue 22:00 → 02:00 · 📍 Noxe Barcelona
📊 33 interested on RA · also on DICE, Eventbrite, Xceed
💶 Free guest list
💬 House night on the 26th floor of the W with a free guest list and city views. Listed on four platforms, the strongest club signal for a Tuesday; expect 100–200, dressy international crowd.
https://ra.co/events/2569428

5. Barcelona Entrepreneurs • Tuesday Meetup
🕘 Tue 19:30 → 22:30 · 📍 ICON BCN
📊 21 going on Meetup (limit 100) · group has 9,242 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Weekly open networking for founders and startup people at a coworking space. Small but real: likely 20–40 once the Eventbrite sign-ups are added. The tech-crowd option for the night.
https://www.meetup.com/barcelona-entrepreneurs-and-startups/events/317287981/

Scanned: Meetup 218 · RA 15 · DICE 4 · Xceed 11 · Eventbrite 124 · Luma 6 · Instagram 27 posts + 15 stories.
